cohort: 202 infants born at Lucile Packard Children's Hospital (LPCH) from July 25, 2013, through July 25, 2014, who were 37 weeks postmenstrual age or older and stable
finding: Fundus hemorrhages were common (20.3%) in newborns, often involving multiple retinal areas and layers, with vaginal delivery significantly increasing risk and Hispanic/Latino ethnicity showing a protective effect.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a significantly increased risk of FH.
